description: Read the debug inspector of a game open in a browser by a member of its workspace (the play page, Bevy player): frame rate and frame time (p50/p95/p99, worst, slow frames, stages of a frame), GPU and backend (webgpu, webgl2, vulkan, dx12, metal…, software rasteriser or not), draws, meshes, triangles, materials, lights, textures and their memory, entities, memory; the modes (wireframe, colliders, bounds), the selection, hidden and outlined nodes, the debug modes the kits registered and their data; with tree=true the scene tree (scenes, nodes, meshes with vertices / triangles / material, world boxes) within depth and max_nodes. JSON contract gripforge.debug/1, identical on every engine. The inspector is open to everyone by default; a game where the developer turned it off (kit debug.inspector config enabled: false, set with gripforge_gamekit_configure) answers "not open to this viewer". Use it to find why a game is slow or wrong before changing it. Same rights as the panel: members of the workspace. 0 credits.

max_nodes.description: Nodes of the tree at most (default 2000).

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

session_id.description: A play session (play-…) of gripforge_runtime_sessions; default: the latest play page of the project.

tree.description: Also build the scene tree (default false).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the page to answer (default 8); 0 answers at once with status received.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_debug_snapshot
title: Debug snapshot of a running game
